title: Picker becomes real agent — Bash / file / web_search / web_fetch / code_exec / subagent tools (Claude-Code-equivalent)
goal: Close the 'AegisPT picker IS Mythos' capability gap. Currently AegisPT picker has tool-pick-from-list affordances. Give it the same agentic toolset Claude has in interactive sessions: Bash exec (sandboxed), file r/w (scope-bounded), web_search + web_fetch, code execution (Python sandbox), subagent spawn. Per user insight: 'you ARE Mythos — same model, different scaffolding'.
scope: (1) New `api/app/agents/agent_tools/` module: BashTool, FileReadTool, FileWriteTool, WebSearchTool, WebFetchTool, CodeExecTool, SubagentSpawnTool — each as Anthropic tool-use schema. (2) Register tools with picker via Claude Messages API tools parameter. (3) Per backlog-409 Governance: every tool call routed through control_plane.authorize_dispatch(). (4) Per backlog-407 OTEL: every tool invocation traced. (5) Sandbox isolation: Bash + CodeExec run in Docker per backlog-409 sandbox_runner.
generation_reason: Per user 2026-05-20: 'R&D budget van Mythos heb jij al in je — jij bent Mythos. Same model, different scaffolding'. Picker-as-tool-selector cannot do what Claude-as-agent does. This task closes the agentic affordance gap. Per ANTI_DRIFT.md Rule 1: metric is 'XBOW challenges solved via agentic tools (Bash/web/code) ≥3'.

constraints.active_task_gate: Single active task AND ANTI_DRIFT.md loaded.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: 7 agent tools + registration + governance integration. NO new picker decision logic beyond exposing tools.
constraints.sandboxed_default: Bash + CodeExec ALWAYS in Docker sandbox per backlog-409.
constraints.scope_allowlist_for_files: FileRead/FileWrite restricted to engagement scope dirs (e.g. /tmp/aegispt-run-{run_id}/), never host paths.
constraints.no_credential_leak: WebFetch/WebSearch redacted in OTEL traces (URLs + bodies sanitized for credentials).

success_criteria: Metric: ≥3 XBOW challenges solved via agentic tool use (Bash exec OR web research informed exploit, verifiable in traces).
Metric: 100% of agentic tool calls routed through control_plane (sentinel test).
Metric: 100% of agentic tool calls traced via OTEL (Langfuse coverage check).
Metric: Bash/CodeExec sandbox isolation enforced — no host-process exec for agent-invoked commands.
All 7 tools functional + unit-tested in isolation.
Live (after-422 XBOW): score climbs +10-15% via agentic tool use.

acceptance_criteria: ≥3 XBOW challenges solved via agentic tools.

after_completion: Update DONE_LOG.md with tool-use count + governance routing + XBOW delta + pre-commit checklist per ANTI_DRIFT.md.
